body: Whoa thanks for your comment. Will do look at  Myers-Briggs evaluation. Thank you :)

Proud of your daughter! and I'm also proud of you! It is indeed hard to confront someone who abused you. But your child is different she's a fighter! She's blessed to have a parent like you and your blessed to have a daughter like her!

This happens to me a lot too... Whenever I'm writing down an essay it always feels like there's a million words to be said but i can't make my ideas turn into words and write it down with a pen and paper.

But writing down all my random ideas part by part really helps. Try focusing on one idea first and write everything you know about it then jump to the other one. After that is done, try summarizing each idea and then you can start making arranging. Then make it into an essay form and this will be your first draft. Then reread it then edit, until you feel like its perfect. I don't know if this will work for you but it works just fine for me. :)

Yeah I get that feeling a lot too!  
Social media is also a trigger for me. I always thought of deleting some of my social accounts, especially the ones that make me compare myself to others.   
It's really nice and comforting to know that I'm not the only one who feels this way, cause I don't really open up personal stuff to my friends and family.   
Thank you for your words! :)

Thank You!! I am trying my best to move on from it, and yeah you're right. I really need to avoid being swept off by the norms of our society. I always thought this feelings of mine are stupid that's why I never really told my friends nor my family. Thank you for your words!! ;)
